description: Republish (full-replace) an existing multi-file BrewPage site in place at the SAME URL/ID. Requires owner token. The uploaded bundle becomes the complete new file set — files absent from it are removed, new files added, matching files overwritten. Single-page: `entryContent`. Multi-page: `files` (array of `{path, content}`). Optional `entry` overrides the default `index.html`. Republishing preserves existing expiry. Old publications (made before 5 October 2026) are read-only: 409 OLD_PUBLICATION_READ_ONLY with createUrl to publish anew. Default limits (current values: GET /api/limits): a request is at most 25 MiB; a site at most 200 files, 5 MiB per file and 20 MiB in total; each path at most 380 characters. System files (.DS_Store, __MACOSX/ and similar) are skipped and never count; files with an unsupported extension or a too-long path are skipped and listed in notices. Entry: `entry`, else root index.html, else the shallowest HTML file. Errors: 400 = a site limit exceeded (the message names it), invalid path, no HTML file, or a PDF/Office file unreadable or password-protected; 413 = request over 25 MiB, too many files and form fields, or a file name/path too long; 422 = no servable file left; 503 = busy, retry after Retry-After seconds. BrewPage tokens and manage links must never be in public content.

entryContent.description: HTML content for a single-page site (entry file). Mutually exclusive with `files`.

files.description: Multi-file site: array of `{path, content}`. Mutually exclusive with `entryContent`.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

tags.description: Optional tags; replace the site's stored tags. Omit to keep them.

ttlDays.description: Ignored: republishing keeps the existing expiry; a supplied value comes back as a ttl-ignored notice.

name: republish_site
title: Republish site
